actions.label: Update node
actions.model_hint: Patch an existing node by nodeId (keeps z-order). Geometry: x,y,width,height. Morph shape: shapeType=rect|ellipse|circle|triangle|polygon|star|line|arrow|… (rect→circle = update_node shapeType=circle on same id — NEVER delete+create_shape). Style: fill (solid hex/rgba only — NEVER CSS linear-gradient()/radial-gradient()), fillType=solid|linear|radial|angular|diffuse|image?, fillEnd?, gradientAngle?, stroke,borderWidth,strokeAlign=center|inside|outside (default center; selection chrome sits on mid of stroke band), strokeStyle, strokeLinecap, strokeLinejoin, strokeOpacity, opacity,cornerRadius,rotation,blendMode,name, flipX/flipY, text styles…. Gradients: fillType=linear|radial|angular|diffuse + fill + fillEnd (+ gradientAngle?). Pencil edits: brushStyle (vector-ink|vector-even|vector-calligraphy|vector-pencil|vector-marker|vector-brush|vector-fountain|vector-technical|vector-soft), borderWidth (Size), pathPressure csv, pressureEnabled, pencilFill, pencilOutlineWidth, pencilOutlineColor. Visibility/edit: hidden, locked (boolean).

args_schema.fill: string? solid hex/rgba — never CSS gradient()
args_schema.name: string?

actions.label: Create shape
actions.model_hint: Add a shape. Args: shapeType = rect|ellipse|circle|line|arrow|triangle|polygon|star|path|pen|pencil (+ path for pen/pencil/path; sides for polygon/star), x,y,width,height, fill, stroke, borderWidth, strokeAlign=center|inside|outside (default center — ink + selection indicator sit on stroke mid-band; outside/inside shift the band). Fills: solid → fill=#RRGGBB|rgba(…); gradient → fillType=linear|radial|angular|diffuse + fill + fillEnd + gradientAngle? (example vignette: fillType=linear fill=rgba(0,0,0,0) fillEnd=rgba(0,0,0,0.35) gradientAngle=90). NEVER put CSS linear-gradient()/radial-gradient()/conic-gradient() in fill — rejected by host. Diffuse may pass meshSize/meshPoints. Optional: strokeStyle, strokeLinecap, strokeLinejoin, strokeOpacity. Pen=pen+path (icons: closed path for filled silhouettes). Pencil/板绘=shapeType pencil: filled-ribbon silhouette around an M/L centerline (same outline for live preview and commit). path M/L only; borderWidth=Size (Px); stroke=ribbon fill color. brushStyle=vector-ink|vector-even|vector-calligraphy|vector-pencil|vector-marker|vector-brush|vector-fountain|vector-technical|vector-soft (default vector-ink). Optional pathPressure (csv 0–1, same length as points), pressureEnabled (default true when pathPressure set), pencilFill, pencilOutlineWidth, pencilOutlineColor. Line/arrow are open center strokes (full arrow path includes head). Icons: prefer primitives + boolean_op (cutouts/combines); create_svg/create_icon only for simple single-path marks. For Q-illustration / pencil sketch do NOT collage with circles — use multiple pencil strokes with pressure.

args_schema.path: string? SVG d or point list for pen/pencil
args_schema.pressureEnabled: boolean? use pathPressure for width (default true when pathPressure set)
args_schema.fill: string? solid hex/rgba only — never CSS gradient()
args_schema.name: string?

actions.label: Create path
actions.model_hint: Add a path/pen polyline as a shape node. Args: x,y,width,height, points=[[x,y],...] (>=2), closed?, stroke?, borderWidth?. For freehand calligraphy use create_shape shapeType=pencil instead.

actions.label: Edit path points
actions.model_hint: Replace path/pen/pencil geometry on an existing node. Args: nodeId, points=[[x,y],...] (>=2), closed?.

actions.label: Append path points
actions.model_hint: Append points to an existing path/pen/pencil node (continue a stroke). Args: nodeId, points=[[x,y],...] (>=1).

actions.label: Simplify path
actions.model_hint: Reduce path/pen/pencil vertices (Ramer–Douglas–Peucker). Args: nodeId, tolerance? (px, default 2).

actions.label: Apply brush preset
actions.model_hint: Set pencil/path stroke preset. Args: nodeIds, preset=ink|pencil|marker|calligraphy|brush.

actions.label: Smooth path
actions.model_hint: Chaikin-smooth a path/pen/pencil. Args: nodeId, iterations? (1-4, default 1).

actions.label: Close path
actions.model_hint: Close an open path/pen/pencil (writes Z). Args: nodeId. Needs at least 3 points.

actions.label: Create text
actions.model_hint: Add a text node. Args: text, x, y, width?, fontSize?, fill?, fontWeight?, fontFamily?. fontFamily only from Available fonts, and only when that face is ~≥90% similar to the needed look. Hero/main titles below that bar → prefer create_image+letteringText instead of forcing a near calligraphy font. Do not invent font names. Do not map 书法感→Zhi Mang Xing by default.

actions.label: Outline text
actions.model_hint: Convert text node(s) to editable path letterforms (fontkit). Args: nodeId or nodeIds[]. Target must be text with content. After outline: style with update_node fill/stroke; combine letterforms with boolean_op. Prefer create_text + fontFamily only when Available fonts ~≥90% match; use outline_text when you need path geometry (boolean, warp, stroke-only glyphs). FE runs this async — do not expect sync create_shape path as a substitute unless fonts cannot outline.

actions.label: Create image
actions.model_hint: Add an image node. Args: src or attachmentIndex (user attach), x,y,width,height. Or genPrompt for AI image hydrate. Optional letteringText=visible text in the image (helps later replaceText). Atmosphere/poster heroes: genPrompt must be SCENE ONLY — no baked titles/dates/logos; put copy in create_text. Finished poster refs with baked text: STYLE only — prefer genPrompt clean bg, not full-bleed attachmentIndex. Lettering gate: use create_text+fontFamily only if Available fonts match the needed look ~≥90%; otherwise (esp. hero/main title) genPrompt + letteringText. Do not hardcode brush/calligraphy mood → catalog calligraphy font.

actions.label: Create SVG
actions.model_hint: Add SVG icon/illustration. Args: svg (required), x,y,width,height, fill?. svg = full <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">…</svg> OR fragment (<path d="…"/> / <circle…/>). path d: use spaced commands Mm Ll Hh Vv Cc Ss Qq Tt Aa Zz + numbers; never glue arc params (bad: a22001…). Backend rejects invalid SVG and retries. For constructed icons with cutouts, prefer create_shape + boolean_op / pen over one giant path.

actions.label: Create Lottie
actions.model_hint: Add a Lottie / Bodymovin motion plate. Prefer genPrompt (natural-language motion brief) — backend hydrates to animationData. Or pass animationData (Bodymovin JSON object/string with layers + w/h). Args: genPrompt and/or animationData, x,y,width,height, name?, durationSec? (hint for hydrate, default 3). Use for UI motion (loading, success, empty-state loop), not for static icons (use create_shape/boolean/create_svg) and not for video (create_image/video flows).

args_schema.name: string?
args_schema.replaceNodeId: string? fill an existing Lottie generator plate

actions.label: Create icon
actions.model_hint: Compact SVG mark (same as create_svg). REQUIRED: non-empty svg string with <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"> and at least one <path d="…"> (or simple shapes). Prefer viewBox 0 0 24 24; valid path d only. NEVER use emoji/text as the mark — that is create_text, not create_icon. Empty svg is rejected. For icons that need cutouts/combines, prefer create_shape + boolean_op or pen instead of one giant path.

actions.label: Create frame
actions.model_hint: Create a frame/artboard. Args: x,y,width,height,name?. Fixed-size poster/mobile/H5/banner: MUST create_frame first at the deliverable size — never replace the artboard with a full-bleed create_shape bg rect. Exception only if the user explicitly refuses a frame (不要画板/自由画布/不要 create_frame). Multi-screen or multi-poster: one create_frame per board (name it), then that board's content, then the next create_frame — do not merge into one tall frame.

actions.label: Duplicate frame
actions.model_hint: Clone an artboard (size/background). Args: frameId, dx?, dy?, name?, includeChildren? (default false; true copies bound nodes).

actions.label: Reorder frames
actions.model_hint: Z-order artboards in the world stack. Args: frameIds, action=front|back|forward|backward.

actions.label: Fit frame to content
actions.model_hint: Resize/move an artboard to wrap its bound children. Args: frameId, padding? (px, default 24).

actions.label: Delete nodes
actions.model_hint: Remove nodes by id. Args: nodeIds (string[]). Only when user asked to delete.

actions.label: Hide nodes
actions.model_hint: Hide or show scene nodes. Args: nodeIds, hidden? (default true).

actions.label: Update frame
actions.model_hint: Update frame size/name/background/lock/clip. Args: frameId (must match FOCUS_FRAME_ID when set), width?, height?, name?, backgroundColor?, locked?, hidden?, clipContent?. When FOCUS_FRAME_ID is present, always use that id — never retarget by name.

actions.label: Lock frames
actions.model_hint: Lock or unlock artboards (prevent move/resize). Args: frameIds, locked? (default true).

actions.label: Hide frames
actions.model_hint: Hide or show artboards. Args: frameIds, hidden? (default true).

actions.label: Clip frames
actions.model_hint: Clip artboard contents to the frame rect. Args: frameIds, clipContent? (default true).

actions.label: Delete frame
actions.model_hint: Delete a frame. Args: frameId|id from SCENE_FRAMES. Destructive — first turn must ask confirmation via choice_ui (mode=confirm, apply+dismiss); emit this op only after user confirms. Never put ids in reply.

actions.label: Align nodes
actions.model_hint: Align 2+ nodes. Args: nodeIds, mode=left|centerX|right|top|middle|bottom (FE reads mode; centerX not center).

actions.label: Distribute nodes
actions.model_hint: Distribute 3+ nodes. Args: nodeIds, axis=h|v (h=horizontal, v=vertical)

actions.label: Reorder z-index
actions.model_hint: Z-order. Args: nodeIds, action=front|back|forward|backward

actions.label: Group
actions.model_hint: Group nodes. Args: nodeIds

actions.label: Ungroup
actions.model_hint: Ungroup. Args: nodeIds (group ids)

actions.label: Duplicate nodes
actions.model_hint: Duplicate nodes. Args: nodeIds, offsetX?, offsetY?

actions.label: Flip nodes
actions.model_hint: Flip nodes. Args: nodeIds, flipX?=true and/or flipY?=true

actions.label: Rotate nodes
actions.model_hint: Set absolute rotation in degrees. Args: nodeIds, rotation.

actions.label: Bind nodes to frame
actions.model_hint: Bind scene nodes to an artboard (attrs.frameId). Args: nodeIds, frameId.

actions.label: Unbind nodes
actions.model_hint: Clear artboard binding on nodes. Args: nodeIds.

actions.label: Boolean ops
actions.model_hint: Boolean on shapes — primary tool for constructed icons (cutouts/combines). Args: nodeIds (2+ from SCENE), mode=union|subtract|intersect|exclude. Examples: moon=large circle subtract small; magnifier=circle union handle rect; ring=outer circle subtract inner. Prefer this over dumping create_svg when the mark can be built from primitives/pen.

actions.label: Canvas background
actions.model_hint: Set infinite-canvas stage background (not artboard fill). Args: color (solid hex/rgba — never CSS gradient()), fillType?=solid|linear|radial|angular|diffuse|image, fillEnd?, gradientAngle?, opacity?

actions.label: Viewport
actions.model_hint: Zoom/fit. Args: action=zoom_in|zoom_out|fit|set; for set pass percent (e.g. 100).

actions.label: Active tool
actions.model_hint: Switch the editor tool. Args: tool=select|pan|frame|text|shape|image|pen|pencil. Prefer document ops (create_path/create_shape) over leaving the user in a drawing tool.

actions.label: Grid snap
actions.model_hint: Toggle canvas grid snap. Args: enabled (boolean).

actions.label: Image process
actions.model_hint: Run image toolbar pipeline on a node (spawns processing clone). Args: nodeId (image id), kind=upscale|eraser|replaceText|multiAngle|expand|adjust|crop|flipRotate|moveObject|vector. replaceText=i2i swap lettering (meta.originalText + meta.newText). Optional: targetWidth, targetHeight, meta (object).

actions.label: Export
actions.model_hint: Export canvas/selection download. Args: format=png|jpeg|svg, nodeIds? (selection), multiplier? (scale, default 1), filename?

stale_if_contains: MUST be chosen from the Available fonts catalog when the style exists there
ONLY when Needed style is NOT in Available fonts
